name: Swamp Druid
summary: A marshland guardian who crosses bogs freely, resists disease and swarms, and ultimately becomes impossible to restrain.

features.name: Marshwight
features.summary: In swamp terrain, add half Druid level to initiative, Swim, and key exploration skills and leave no trail.

features.name: Swamp Strider
features.summary: Ignore movement, Acrobatics, and Stealth penalties in bogs and undergrowth.

features.name: Pond Scum
features.summary: Gain +4 against disease and monstrous-humanoid abilities, plus DR against swarms that also blocks their special attacks.
features.scaling: swarm DR equal to half Druid level
